parameters.name: AuditLogStore
parameters.description: The Simple Log Service Logstore that is used to store the audit logs.

parameters.name: AuditProject
parameters.description: The Simple Log Service project that is used to store the audit logs.

parameters.name: AuditRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the audit logs are stored.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: CpuArch
parameters.description: CPU architectures are divided into ARM architecture and x86 architecture.

parameters.name: ExpireDate
parameters.description: The time at which the container ends to be added.

parameters.name: Vendor
parameters.description:
The service provider of the cloud asset. Valid values:

*   **Tencent**
*   **HUAWEICLOUD**
*   **Azure**
*   **AWS**
*   **Others**
